The supplied supplement embeds the selector implementation \texttt{ada/adapt\_qsci/run.py}, but not its numerical inputs \texttt{parent.npz}, \texttt{H-active.npz} and \texttt{V-active.npz}, or the recorded build implementation \texttt{ada/adapt\_qsci/build.py} and its \texttt{build-result.json}. Nor are the selector outputs \texttt{ada/adapt\_qsci/result.json} (including saved run histories and gates), \texttt{summary.json}, \texttt{audit-result.json} and \texttt{stopping\_accuracy\_audit\_result.json}, or \texttt{emmy/finite\_shot\_result\_audit\_result.json}; the associated summarising and replay scripts are not embedded either.
